title: Local Transcribe transcript, format version 1
description: A transcript written by Local Transcribe (clip.transcript.json next to the media). Times are whole milliseconds from the start of the media. Readers ignore fields they do not know. See docs/format/README.md for the version rule.

version.description: Major version. A reader refuses a higher major version.

minor.description: Minor version: only adds optional fields. Absent means 0. A reader accepts any minor version of its major version.

language.description: Language code as Whisper gives it (nl, en, ...), or empty when unknown.

engine.description: What made the transcript. Informative; readers do not depend on it, except for name.

name.description: mlx-whisper for a transcription, local-transcribe-refined for a transcript corrected in Refine.

source.description: Where the transcript belongs. Next to the media: connector local, with the fingerprint and the file name of the media (never a path).

fingerprint.description: sha256 over the size and the first, middle and last MiB of the media, first 32 hex characters.

media.description: File name of the media, without folder.

refined.description: True when someone corrected the transcript in Refine.

id.description: Fixed within one transcript; segments refer to it.

name.description: What people see: "Spreker 1" or a name someone filled in.

tracks.description: The audio tracks of the media as the track analysis saw them.

number.description: 1, 2, ... as ffprobe counts them, channels separately.

label.description: Free text for people, in the language of the app (for example timecode, silence, same signal as track 2). Not meant to be parsed.

used.description: Taken into the audio that was transcribed.

segments.description: Blocks of text of one speaker, in order of time.

text.description: Only when the text differs from the words joined with spaces (after a correction in Refine).

words.description: Each word as [text, start, end, score]; score is the recognition confidence from 0 to 1.
